verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.customer.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200). The docs also expose section-level llms.txt files (ai, messaging, accounts, integrations), llms-full.txt, a marketing-site llms.txt, Markdown (.md) versions of doc pages, and an OpenAPI spec flagged for agents. Customer.io also ships agent skills that teach AI assistants to drive its CLI. Missing for 10: no independent or community hands-on report of agents actually consuming these docs successfully.
